Employee.GetByDepartmentId: SELECT * FROM employee WHERE DepartmentID=@DepartmentID AND IsDeleted = FALSE
Employee.GetByPositionId: SELECT * FROM employee WHERE PositionID=@PositionID AND IsDeleted = FALSE
Department.GetEmployeeByDepartmentCode: SELECT * FROM employee e JOIN department d ON e.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID WHERE d.DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode
Department.GetEmployeeCountByDepartmentC: SELECT COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount FROM department d INNER JOIN employee e ON d.DepartmentID = e.DepartmentID WHERE d.DepartmentCode = @DepartmentCode
